name: Ventures
description: The agency's venture arm: every company we hold equity in, what we put in, what the stake is marked at today, what has come back, and what it returned.

archetype.coreJob: Know what we put into each company, what the stake is worth now, and what it returned

entities.label: Holding
entities.description: A company we have invested in, or are about to.

fields.label: Company record
fields.help: The shared Organizations record for this company. A holding is the INVESTMENT - stake, entry, valuation, exit - and the company it is a stake in is the same company the CRM and Invoicing deal with, which is why five of these are also clients.

fields.label: Stage
fields.help: The company's funding stage at our latest ticket.

fields.label: Relationship
fields.help: How the company relates to the agency side of the business.

fields.label: First invested
fields.help: Stamped automatically the first time the holding is funded.

fields.label: Ownership %
fields.help: Our fully diluted share of the company, from the latest cap table.

fields.label: Current value
fields.help: What our stake is marked at today. Use “Record valuation” rather than editing this by hand — that keeps the mark history.

fields.label: Total value
fields.help: The mark plus everything already distributed — what the holding is worth to us all in.

fields.label: Multiple
fields.help: Total value over money in. 1.0 is break-even.

fields.label: Returned
fields.help: Cash actually back in the bank, over money in.

fields.label: Return p.a.
fields.help: Annualized return between the entry date and the latest mark. Empty until the holding has both.

entities.label: Investment
entities.description: One cheque into a holding. Follow-ons are separate rows.

entities.label: Valuation
entities.description: A mark: what our stake was worth on a given date, and how we arrived at it.

entities.label: Distribution
entities.description: Money coming back out of a holding.

entities.label: Update
entities.description: What the founders told us this quarter.

commands.label: Commit
commands.successMessage: Committed — fund it once the money moves.

confirm.title: Fund this holding?
confirm.message: Marks the holding as held and stamps the entry date. Add the cheque itself as an investment row.

confirm.title: Record the exit?
confirm.message: Books the proceeds as a distribution and clears the mark — the holding is no longer on the books at a value.

confirm.title: Write this holding off?
confirm.message: Marks the stake at zero. The investment history stays on file.

workflows.name: Stamp the entry date on first funding

roles.name: Partner
roles.description: Runs the venture arm: adds holdings, writes cheques, records marks and exits.

roles.name: Analyst
roles.description: Keeps the marks and the paperwork current, but cannot remove anything.

roles.name: Viewer
roles.description: Sees the portfolio and its returns, changes nothing.
